blocks_element.text: IS THE FLASHER PRO SAFE FOR ALL HAIR AND SKIN TYPES?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · The Flasher Pro is safe and effective …
blocks_element.text:
The Flasher Pro is safe and effective for a wide range of hair and skin types.

Skin rejuvenation using the ageless lens is suitable for Fitzpatrick Skin Tones I - IV, as seen below, regardless of hair color.

Long-lasting hair removal using the hairless lens requires high contrast between the melanin in your hair and your skin, meaning it may not be suitable for very light blonde, red, or gray hair, or for deeper skin tones. See below chart for reference.

IPL is not safe or suitable for brown or dark-brown to black skin tones. See chart below or reference Fitzpatrick Skin Tones V - VI.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · We recommend completing a Skin Safety …

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · WHY IS CONSISTENCY IMPORTANT FOR IPL T…
blocks_element.text: WHY IS CONSISTENCY IMPORTANT FOR IPL TREATMENTS?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · For hair removal, IPL and laser hair r…
blocks_element.text: For hair removal, IPL and laser hair removal work by targeting hair follicles in the anagen (active growth) phase. Since not all hairs are in this phase at the same time, consistent treatments ensure that more follicles are treated during their active phase, leading to better results. For skin rejuvenation, consistency is important for IPL treatments because the effects build gradually over time. Regular use of the Flasher Pro helps to maintain an even skin tone and improve overall skin appearance. Since the skin naturally renews itself over several weeks, consistent treatments help users achieve and maintain visible improvements in texture and brightness. Sticking to a routine also ensures that treated areas receive the full benefits of IPL technology.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · HOW OFTEN SHOULD I USE MY DEVICE?
blocks_element.text: HOW OFTEN SHOULD I USE MY DEVICE?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · For hair removal, use the Flasher Pro …
blocks_element.text: For hair removal, use the Flasher Pro with the hair removal lens every 3 days for up to 12 weeks and then every month. For skin rejuvenation, use the Flasher Pro with the ageless lens 2 to 3 times per week on an ongoing basis for optimal results.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · WHY DO I NEED TO SHAVE BEFORE TREATMEN…
blocks_element.text: WHY DO I NEED TO SHAVE BEFORE TREATMENT?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · For hair removal, shaving ensures that…
blocks_element.text: For hair removal, shaving ensures that the light from the Flasher Pro directly targets the hair follicle, rather than being dispersed across the hair. This improves the effectiveness of the treatment and enhances long-term results. It’s important that the skin is clean, dry, and free from any lotions, creams, or self-tanners before use to ensure optimal light absorption and effectiveness.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · WHERE CAN I USE MY FLASHER?
blocks_element.text: WHERE CAN I USE MY FLASHER?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · The Flasher Pro can be used anywhere o…
blocks_element.text: The Flasher Pro can be used anywhere on your face or body, including the arms, underarms, hands, legs, chin, neck, back, and bikini line. However, it is not suitable to be used on areas immediately surrounding the eyes or on the eyebrows. Refer to the included instructional manual in your device for a full list of recommended treatment areas.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · CAN USING THE FLASHER PRO SKIN REJUVEN…
blocks_element.text: CAN USING THE FLASHER PRO SKIN REJUVENATION LENS ALSO REDUCE HAIR?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Yes, because the Flasher Pro uses IPL …
blocks_element.text: Yes, because the Flasher Pro uses IPL (Intense Pulsed Light) technology, the skin rejuvenation lens may also reduce hair in treated areas over time. While the primary goal of skin rejuvenation treatments is to improve skin tone and texture, IPL energy is designed to target pigment, which includes hair follicles. If you wish to maintain hair in certain areas, consider this before using the device for skin rejuvenation.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · IS THE HAIR LOSS PERMANENT?
Paragraphe · Yes. IPL treatments permanently reduce…
blocks_element.text: Yes. IPL treatments permanently reduce hair regrowth. You can see up to a 95% reduction in hair regrowth after following the recommended treatment schedule. Since IPL targets hair in the anagen phase, some hairs that were in a different phase during treatment may still grow. This is why periodic maintenance treatments (once or twice a month) are recommended.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Unlike laser hair removal, IPL or inte…
blocks_element.text: Unlike laser hair removal, IPL or intense pulsed light hair removal is generally considered to be much safer and less painful. This is because IPL uses a multi-spectrum bulb vs a single-wavelength laser. You may feel a slight tingle in sensitive areas during treatment, but it should not be painful.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · HOW LONG DOES IT TAKE TO SEE RESULTS?
blocks_element.text: HOW LONG DOES IT TAKE TO SEE RESULTS?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · For hair removal treatments, hair grow…
blocks_element.text: For hair removal treatments, hair growth cycles vary depending on the body area. For example, hair on the legs and arms has a longer growth cycle than hair in the underarms or bikini line. As a result, some areas may show results faster than others. For skin rejuvenation, results from IPL skin rejuvenation treatments vary based on individual skin characteristics and concerns. Some users may notice subtle improvements in skin tone and texture after just a few sessions, while more visible changes—such as a reduction in pigmentation irregularities or redness—can take several weeks. Since IPL works with the skin’s natural renewal cycle, most users see the best results after consistent use for 8 to 12 weeks. Following the recommended treatment schedule and protecting the skin from excessive sun exposure can help optimize results.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · WHAT IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN IPL AND…
blocks_element.text: WHAT IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN IPL AND LASER HAIR REMOVAL?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · The key difference is the type of ligh…
blocks_element.text: The key difference is the type of light used: IPL (Intense Pulsed Light) uses a broad-spectrum pulsed light. Laser hair removal uses a single, concentrated wavelength of light. Both methods target melanin in the hair follicle for long-term hair reduction. Factors such as energy level, frequency, and hair color impact effectiveness more than the choice between IPL and laser.

blocks_element.text: I'm amazed at how well the Nood Flasher Pro is working. I've always struggled with sensitive skin in my bikini area, and have tried other laser devices that were ineffective and sooo painful. I'm ecstatic that I tried Nood! Here's what I love: 1) The laser window is fairly large, so it covers a large area pretty quickly. I did an entire leg in only 10 minutes. 2) It's a very tolerable treatment in terms of burning/stinging sensation. I can use it on the highest setting, and while it can sting, it's completely tolerable, and the cooling mechanism helps. On some areas of my body it feels like a warm flash and doesn't hurt at all. After treatment, I have felt a very mild sting for a few minutes, up to maybe 30 minutes at most. 3) The ageless lens is a great bonus! I've used it to reduce sun damage/redness on my chest and face, and it's working, though with less obvious results than the hair removal. 4) My bikini lines are mostly smooth and hairless after only 3 quick treatments! Amazing!
